verdict.rationale: YubiKey ships cloud services alongside the hardware, namely YubiCloud OTP validation and the YubiEnterprise console and API, so data residency is a fair question to ask. The evidence documents no way to choose a storage region or residency for those services. Secrets being kept on the device's secure element is a related security property, not a user-selectable region, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
